audit_items.proof_trace: The Merkle proof in `_verifyCanClaimExcessCapital` (L764) constructs the leaf as `keccak256(keccak256(abi.encode(investor, investedCapital - amount)))` and verifies it against `acceptedCapitalMerkleRoot`; this forces `amount == investedCapital - acceptedCapital`. The transfer at L350 sends exactly `amount`, so `transferAmount == investedCapital - acceptedCapital` always holds when the proof passes. All alternative paths that could modify `investedCapital` before this call (refund, cancel-withdrawal) are gated by mutually-exclusive modifiers or explicit checks (`_verifyHasNotRefunded`), and `hasClaimedExcess` prevents double-claiming.
